records.caption: A* - Priority queue ordered by g(n)+h(n).
records.learning_goal: Read f(n)=g(n)+h(n) and the Manhattan optimality condition.
records.mechanism: Priority queue ordered by g(n)+h(n).
records.evidence: g/h/f, expanded/generated/frontier, legal path and optimality flag.
records.guarantee: Optimal with admissible and consistent heuristic when resources do not stop the run.
records.academic_caveat: The certificate is valid only for the selected goal and heuristic contract.

records.caption: AI-vs-AI Tournament - Run two solvers and classify verified trajectories.
records.learning_goal: Score two agents against the same A* reference.
records.mechanism: Run two solvers and classify verified trajectories.
records.evidence: points, optimal cost, excess cost and invalid-path penalties.
records.guarantee: Fair benchmark when the reference certificate exists.
records.academic_caveat: Tournament is not a natural adversarial PEAS model.

records.caption: AND-OR Search - OR chooses action; AND requires subplans for supported outcomes.
records.learning_goal: Read a conditional plan under possible outcome deflections.
records.mechanism: OR chooses action; AND requires subplans for supported outcomes.
records.evidence: conditional branches, depth limit and deflection support mode.
records.guarantee: Returns a policy-like conditional plan, not a linear shortest path.
records.academic_caveat: The support switch is not probability weighting.
records.result_message:
Conditional plan found (depth limit=2). AND-OR requires every supported outcome to succeed. Deflection support=intended outcome only; nondet_prob>0 adds all legal deflections, not probability-weighted branches.
OR: choose action R (h=1.0)

records.caption: Alpha-Beta Pruning - Prune branches that cannot change the minimax root value.
records.learning_goal: Learn branch-and-bound pruning over the same worst-case tree.
records.mechanism: Prune branches that cannot change the minimax root value.
records.evidence: alpha, beta, pruned branches and root utility.
records.guarantee: Same root value as full Minimax for the searched tree.
records.academic_caveat: Pruning saves nodes; it does not turn the puzzle into a real two-player game.

records.caption: BFS - FIFO frontier over puzzle states.
records.learning_goal: Understand level-order expansion and why unit-cost BFS can certify shortest paths.
records.mechanism: FIFO frontier over puzzle states.
records.evidence: frontier size, reached set, legal path and path cost.
records.guarantee: Complete and optimal for unit step cost if resources suffice.
records.academic_caveat: Memory grows quickly; good for shallow teaching cases, not deep 15-puzzle production search.

records.caption: Backtracking Search - Depth-first assignment with constraint checks.
records.learning_goal: Search assignments in the CSP model.
records.mechanism: Depth-first assignment with constraint checks.
records.evidence: assigned variables, backtrack reason and final path if found.
records.guarantee: Can solve small exact-horizon demos.
records.academic_caveat: Horizon-bound; not a global shortest-path claim.
records.result_message: Bounded transition-planning demo found a path with T=1. This run orders child nodes by Manhattan Distance heuristic, not MRV/forward checking.

records.caption: CSP Definition - Build a state-chain CSP model.
records.learning_goal: Name variables, domains and constraints.
records.mechanism: Build a state-chain CSP model.
records.evidence: variables/domains/constraints count.
records.guarantee: Model definition only.
records.academic_caveat: A model is not yet a solved trajectory.

records.learning_goal: Visualize variables as a constraint network.
records.mechanism: Build graph nodes/edges from CSP relations.
records.evidence: constraint graph summary and consistency evidence.
records.guarantee: Explains structure, not a solver certificate.
records.academic_caveat: Graph readability matters more than path optimality here.

records.caption: Constraint Propagation - Apply AC-3 style propagation.
records.learning_goal: See domains shrink before search.
records.mechanism: Apply AC-3 style propagation.
records.evidence: domain reductions and wipe-out status.
records.guarantee: Sound pruning for represented constraints.
records.academic_caveat: Propagation alone may not decide the puzzle.

records.caption: DFS - LIFO stack with depth-aware duplicate handling.
records.learning_goal: See how depth-first commitment differs from optimal state-space search.
records.mechanism: LIFO stack with depth-aware duplicate handling.
records.evidence: expanded nodes, depth limit and legal trajectory when present.
records.guarantee: No shortest-path guarantee in this app setting.
records.academic_caveat: Can chase a deep branch and miss a shorter path.

records.caption: Expectimax - Replace MIN with CHANCE outcomes and success probability.
records.learning_goal: Compare expected value against worst-case reasoning.
records.mechanism: Replace MIN with CHANCE outcomes and success probability.
records.evidence: CHANCE nodes, probabilities and expected utility.
records.guarantee: Depth-limited expected-value policy under the chosen probability model.
records.academic_caveat: Probability model is educational and must be stated before interpreting the result.

records.caption: Global Constraints - Apply global constraint checks over the state chain.
records.learning_goal: Use all-different and structural constraints.
records.mechanism: Apply global constraint checks over the state chain.
records.evidence: constraint status and domain evidence.
records.guarantee: Rules out impossible assignments.
records.academic_caveat: Does not replace graph-search optimality.
records.result_message:

records.caption: Greedy Best-First - Priority queue ordered only by heuristic h(n).
records.learning_goal: Show why h(n) alone is fast but not a certificate.
records.mechanism: Priority queue ordered only by heuristic h(n).
records.evidence: selected h(n), frontier and whether the final path reaches goal.
records.guarantee: No optimality guarantee.
records.academic_caveat: May find a longer path or get misled by a locally attractive state.

records.caption: IDA* - Depth-first search bounded by increasing f-threshold.
records.learning_goal: Combine A* evaluation with memory-bounded iterative thresholds.
records.mechanism: Depth-first search bounded by increasing f-threshold.
records.evidence: threshold, reached metric, legal path and optimality flag.
records.guarantee: Optimal with admissible heuristic and sufficient threshold iterations.
records.academic_caveat: May revisit many states; trace is threshold-based, not a single frontier queue.

records.caption: IDS - Repeated depth-limited DFS with cutoff tracking.
records.learning_goal: Trade BFS optimality for DFS-like memory by increasing the depth limit.
records.mechanism: Repeated depth-limited DFS with cutoff tracking.
records.evidence: depth limit, cutoff/exhausted reason and legal path.
records.guarantee: Complete and optimal for unit step cost if the limit reaches the solution depth.
records.academic_caveat: Repeats work across iterations; the trace should be read by limit, not as one queue.

records.caption: LRTA* - Update H(s) after observing local successors.
records.learning_goal: Study online heuristic learning one action at a time.
records.mechanism: Update H(s) after observing local successors.
records.evidence: online step, H update, chosen action and cap reason.
records.guarantee: Online learning demo, not an offline optimal certificate.
records.academic_caveat: The node cap is a max online-step cap in the UI.

records.caption: Local Beam Search - Keep k best states per iteration.
records.learning_goal: Track several local candidates at once.
records.mechanism: Keep k best states per iteration.
records.evidence: beam width, candidate scores and selected beam states.
records.guarantee: No optimality guarantee.
records.academic_caveat: The beam can collapse to similar states and miss the global route.

records.caption: Min-Conflicts - Randomized local repair over CSP variables.
records.learning_goal: Repair an assignment by reducing conflicts.
records.mechanism: Randomized local repair over CSP variables.
records.evidence: conflict count, selected variable and seed.
records.guarantee: Useful concept for CSP repair.
records.academic_caveat: Better suited to N-Queens style CSPs than canonical 15-puzzle.
records.result_message: Goal reached after 1 iterations via tile swaps. This is a CSP repair trace, NOT a sequence of legal 15-puzzle moves.

records.caption: Minimax - Alternate MAX promising moves with MIN worst-case legal continuations.
records.learning_goal: Interpret MIN as worst-case robustness, not a real puzzle opponent.
records.mechanism: Alternate MAX promising moves with MIN worst-case legal continuations.
records.evidence: MAX/MIN nodes, utility and selected root action.
records.guarantee: Depth-limited worst-case decision rule.
records.academic_caveat: Both sides share legal blank moves because 15-puzzle has no natural adversary.

records.caption: Path Consistency - Check pair/triple compatibility in the model.
records.learning_goal: Inspect consistency across triples of variables.
records.mechanism: Check pair/triple compatibility in the model.
records.evidence: consistency events and remaining domains.
records.guarantee: Educational consistency evidence.
records.academic_caveat: Not a shortest-path solver.

records.caption: Random-Restart Hill Climbing - Run multiple hill climbs from deterministic restart states.
records.learning_goal: Use restarts to escape one bad local basin.
records.mechanism: Run multiple hill climbs from deterministic restart states.
records.evidence: restart index, best h(n) and selected trajectory.
records.guarantee: Still not a complete 15-puzzle solver here.
records.academic_caveat: More restarts improve chances but do not prove optimality.

records.caption: Searching for partially observable problems - Filter belief candidates using a known-tile matrix.
records.learning_goal: Use known tile positions to reduce the belief set.
records.mechanism: Filter belief candidates using a known-tile matrix.
records.evidence: known positions, belief size, planner votes and fallback reason.
records.guarantee: Can propose legal actions under partial knowledge.
records.academic_caveat: With too few known tiles, the belief set can still be ambiguous.

records.caption: Searching with no observation - Maintain a belief set when observations reveal no tile positions.
records.learning_goal: Separate hidden actual state from belief-state decision making.
records.mechanism: Maintain a belief set when observations reveal no tile positions.
records.evidence: belief size, planner votes, fallback votes and action trace.
records.guarantee: Demonstrates belief reasoning; not a standard full-observation solver.
records.academic_caveat: Hidden state is shown only as debug evidence.
records.result_message: Belief size=4 after 3 steps. No observation keeps a belief set; planner=A* Search cannot safely collapse it.

records.caption: Simple Hill Climbing - Scan neighbors and move to the first lower h(n).
records.learning_goal: Watch the first improving candidate win or the search stop.
records.mechanism: Scan neighbors and move to the first lower h(n).
records.evidence: candidate h, selected action and stop reason.
records.guarantee: No completeness or optimality guarantee.
records.academic_caveat: Local optimum can stop the run far from the goal.

records.caption: Simulated Annealing - Temperature-controlled accept/reject over neighbors.
records.learning_goal: Understand probabilistic acceptance of worse moves.
records.mechanism: Temperature-controlled accept/reject over neighbors.
records.evidence: temperature, probability, accepted flag and legal trajectory.
records.guarantee: No certificate of reaching or optimizing the goal.
records.academic_caveat: A legal trajectory is not automatically a solution.

records.caption: Steepest-Ascent Hill Climbing - Choose the neighbor with best h(n) decrease.
records.learning_goal: Compare all local neighbors before moving.
records.mechanism: Choose the neighbor with best h(n) decrease.
records.evidence: evaluated candidates, best candidate and reject/accept reason.
records.guarantee: No completeness or optimality guarantee.
records.academic_caveat: Still local; evaluating every neighbor does not solve plateaus.

records.caption: Stochastic Hill Climbing - Sample one improving move using a fixed seed.
records.learning_goal: See randomness among improving candidates.
records.mechanism: Sample one improving move using a fixed seed.
records.evidence: candidate pool, chosen action, seed and legal trajectory.
records.guarantee: No deterministic optimality guarantee.
records.academic_caveat: Different seeds can produce different partial trajectories.

records.caption: UCS - Priority queue ordered by cumulative path cost.
records.learning_goal: Connect path cost g(n) to optimal search.
records.mechanism: Priority queue ordered by cumulative path cost.
records.evidence: g(n), frontier, reached and cost certificate.
records.guarantee: Complete and optimal for non-negative costs.
records.academic_caveat: On unit-cost 15-puzzle it behaves like BFS but keeps the general cost model explicit.
